subject.title: [Feature]: Offline Command Queue for iOS/Android Node App

question: Should OpenClaw ship durable mobile offline commands as on-device stored text/voice intents, and what storage, retention, replay, and review-before-send boundary should be accepted first?
rationale: The feature stores private user intent before Gateway delivery and changes message/session replay semantics across mobile apps, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Stage durable outbox with security guardrails
options.body: Approve a narrow v1 only after the payload, idempotency, captured-time, retention, delete, encryption, and redacted-proof expectations are visible.

options.title: Design first, no feature merge yet
options.body: Keep implementation PRs paused until a cross-platform mobile outbox design settles storage and replay semantics.

options.title: Defer durable storage
options.body: Limit near-term work to nonpersistent or foreground-only queues if durable command storage is not acceptable yet.

recommendation.title: Stage durable outbox with security guardrails
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow v1 only after the payload, idempotency, captured-time, retention, delete, encryption, and redacted-proof expectations are visible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current Android outbox candidate and has recent history in the affected Android voice and iOS Watch queue-adjacent paths.
